data.name: TowerKeep - Tower Defense
data.detailed_description:
In TowerKeep you are the architect of your own defense. Across a sprawling land of magic and monsters, you decide everything - where the enemies walk, where your towers stand, and how the world takes shape around them. Fell the forest, work the stone, and turn raw wilderness into a fortress of your own design.

Push deeper into each run to uncover relics that twist and amplify your strategy in ways you never planned for. Every wave hits harder than the last, and the only thing standing between you and defeat is the world you build.

Key Features:

  • Your Land, Your Rules - Build freely across the entire battlefield, with no fixed lanes and no set path. Wind the enemy's route into a twisting labyrinth of your own making. 

  • Build From What You Take - Chop trees for timber, break ground for stone, and raise your walls from the land around you. The wilderness isn't scenery - it's your supply line.

  • A World That Lives - Every biome has its own flora, fauna and rules. Grass slows what walks through it, forests block the way until they're felled, and the ground itself shapes what your towers can do. Learn the land and it will fight beside you.

  • Relics of Untold Power - Discover mysterious relics over the course of each run that reshape how you play. Game-changing effects that can turn the tide of battle.

  • No Two Lands Alike - Procedurally generated worlds and a roguelike progression system mean every run deals you a fresh hand. Read the terrain, adapt your strategy, and go again.

  • Hold The Line - Each run pits you against escalating waves of monsters, each one testing the strength of everything you have built. Plan your defenses, survive the oncoming assault, and fight your way to the end.

data.short_description: In a living land of magic and monsters, the world itself is your greatest weapon. Gather from the land, build your defenses, and hold back the horde. A tower defense where no two lands are ever the same.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU @ 2GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 630 or AMD Radeon HD 7450 equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7, Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU @ 2.3GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1080 equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
